description: Replay verified publication events against measured 1, 5 and 20-observation FX reference returns. Daily windows exclude the publication-day fixing; changes from previous actuals are not consensus surprises. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: FX base currency for market context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

currency.description: Currency for macro event series, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

indicator.description: Indicator slug for event replay. Supported examples: any indicator slug the FXMacroData catalogue lists for the currency, for example inflation, gdp, policy_rate, unemployment.

lookback_events.description: Maximum number of recent events to include in replay.

quote.description: FX quote currency for market context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.
